                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Natural gas is widely used as a fuel and a raw material.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • They are fossil energy sources that were generated years ago beneath the earth’s surface.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ଆଭୋଗାଡ୍ରୋ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ହେଉଛି 6.022 × 1023।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ପଦାର୍ଥ ବିଜ୍ଞାନୀ ତଥା ରସାୟନ ବିଜ୍ଞାନୀ ଆମେଡେଓ ଆଭୋଗାଡ୍ରୋଙ୍କ ନାମରେ ଏହା ନାମିତ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The correct answer is 14.    

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The atomic mass of nitrogen is 14 µ. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Atom: 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • An atom is the smallest invisible unit of matter that constitutes a chemical element.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Every plasma, solid, gas & liquid, is composed of ionized or neutral atoms.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Around 100 picometers across, atoms are extremely small. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Atomic Mass: \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Atomic Theory of Dalton suggested that each element has a unique atomic mass.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The law of constant proportions could be explained easily by the implementation of Dalton's theory.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As the size of an atom is relatively small, it is quite difficult to determine the mass of an atom.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • That's why scientists started evaluating the mass of an atom by differentiating it from the mass of a standard atom.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The atomic mass is 12u (12 atomic mass units).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Thus it states that 1 atomic mass unit = Mass of 1/12 the mass of a carbon-12 atom.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The following table shows the list of elements with the respective atomic masses. \n\t\n\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ElementsAtomic Mass
